title: Reddit launches Reddit Reviews, a built-in hub using AI to turn subreddit comments into product pages with pros, cons, and sentiment, starting with 10K items (Mia Sato/The Verge)
summary: Mia Sato / The Verge: Reddit launches Reddit Reviews, a built-in hub using AI to turn subreddit comments into product pages with pros, cons, and sentiment, starting with 10K items — With a new product reviews hub, Reddit is creating something akin to a crowdsourced Wirecutter.
